ClientAbilities.description:
Catalyst Probes erupt from Lavos and douse combatants in a fiery gel. Damage is doubled for each element afflicting an enemy.

Hold to imbue the next ability cast with <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat.
ClientAbilities.name: Catalyze

ClientAbilities.description:
Lash out with a toxic serpentine strike, consuming the target to heal Lavos.

Hold to imbue all abilities with <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin.
ClientAbilities.name: Ophidian Bite

ClientAbilities.description:
Launch a probe that converts Health and Energy Orbs into Universal Orbs that provide both, and ammo pickups into Universal Ammo Pickups. The probe shocks enemies in close proximity. Each electrocuted foe reduces other ability cooldowns by 1.5s.

Hold to imbue the next ability cast with <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity.
ClientAbilities.name: Transmutation Probe

ClientAbilities.description:
Dash forward, crashing through enemies and leaving an icy trail of broken vials.

Hold to imbue the next ability cast with <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold.
ClientAbilities.name: Vial Rush

ClientAbilities.description: Launch a large particle of charged antimatter that will detonate on contact. Direct the particle by aiming, shoot it to charge it further. Deals <DT_EXPLOSION_COLOR>Blast Damage with a guaranteed Status Effect.
ClientAbilities.name: Antimatter Drop

ClientAbilities.description: Primes all enemies in an expanding radius with volatile antimatter. Press the ability to slow down enemy movement, hold the ability to speed them up.
ClientAbilities.name: Molecular Prime

ClientAbilities.description: Creates antimatter particles that orbit Nova and attack nearby targets. Each active particle reduces damage to Nova's Health and Shields.
ClientAbilities.name: Null Star

ClientAbilities.description: Creates a wormhole allowing instantaneous travel. Hold the ability to visualize placement.
ClientAbilities.name: Wormhole

ClientAbilities.description: Creates a localized storm of punishing explosions.
ClientAbilities.name: Thumper

ClientAbilities.description: Launches a plodding missile capable of unleashing a massive explosion.
ClientAbilities.name: Warhead

ClientAbilities.description: The Itzal Archwing teleports a short distance, dropping all enemy target locks.
ClientAbilities.name: Blink

ClientAbilities.description: Activates a cloaking field that hides the Warframe and any nearby allies who remain stationary.
ClientAbilities.name: Penumbra

ClientAbilities.description: Deploys drones that fight alongside the Warframe, each detonating in a destructive blast when killed.
ClientAbilities.name: Fighter Escort

ClientAbilities.description: The Warframe emits a massive pulse of energy, stunning nearby enemies and sending them flying.
ClientAbilities.name: Repel

ClientAbilities.description: Vents out the Archwing's propulsion core, confusing enemy projectiles and causing them to detonate.
ClientAbilities.name: Core Vent

ClientAbilities.description: Forms a protective energy shell around the Warframe
ClientAbilities.name: Energy Shell

ClientAbilities.description: Drops flare beacons confusing incoming guided missiles.
ClientAbilities.name: Disarray

ClientAbilities.description: Launch a tethered hook that either pulls enemies close, or pulls the Warframe toward any stationary objects it hooks onto.
ClientAbilities.name: Arch Line

ClientAbilities.description: Forms a miniature black hole that sucks in all nearby objects before rupturing in a massive shock wave.
ClientAbilities.name: Cosmic Crush

ClientAbilities.description: Fires a large volley of homing missiles.
ClientAbilities.name: Seeking Fire

ClientAbilities.description: Creates beacons that draw enemy fire, converting the damage into healing pulses.
ClientAbilities.name: Benevolent Decoy

ClientAbilities.description: Tiny drones orbit the Warframe or an ally, and intercept enemy fire.
ClientAbilities.name: Watchful Swarm

ClientAbilities.description: All damage taken is transformed into Energy, while abilities gain enhanced Range, Duration and Power. Affects the Warframe and nearby allies.
ClientAbilities.name: Vengeful Rush

ClientAbilities.description: Renders the Warframe and nearby allies immune to Status Effects, while slowing nearby enemies.
ClientAbilities.name: Warding Grace

ClientAbilities.description: Fires a high-yield, remotely detonated explosive projectile capable of latching onto targets.
ClientAbilities.name: Bloomer

ClientAbilities.description: Banshee emits a sonic shockwave that pushes targets in range with enough force to incapacitate or kill attackers.
ClientAbilities.name: Sonic Boom

ClientAbilities.description: Using Silence surrounds Banshee in an aura that stuns enemies and will limit their perceptions and tactical response to gunfire and Warframe attacks.
ClientAbilities.name: Silence

ClientAbilities.description: Using acoustic location, Banshee's Sonar power finds and tracks enemies, and exposes critical weak spots to everyone in your squad.
ClientAbilities.name: Sonar

ClientAbilities.description: Channeling all of her acoustic energy into the environment, Banshee uses ultrasonic reverberations to violently shake the ground.
ClientAbilities.name: Sound Quake

ClientAbilities.description: Draws power from the decibel level of sound in the area and uses it to amplify a damage buff for Octavia and her allies. It also doubles the damage and range of nearby Mallets.
ClientAbilities.name: Amp

ClientAbilities.description: Launches a rollerball that charms foes to follow it. Combines with the Mallet to create a roving ball of sonic destruction.
ClientAbilities.name: Resonator

ClientAbilities.description: Grants buffs to those who consistently perform actions in time to Octavia's music. Timed jumps offer the Vivace speed buff. Crouching on the beat grants cloaking with the Nocturne buff. Firing rhythmically bestows Opera multishot buff. Timed melee swings give the Forte damage buff.
ClientAbilities.name: Metronome

ClientAbilities.description: Rhythmically beats damage into nearby enemies and draws their fire. Damage inflicted on the Mallet increases its lethality.
ClientAbilities.name: Mallet

ClientAbilities.description: Valkyr lets out a rallying cry that bolsters Armor and Attack Speed for allies while in <AFFINITY_SHARE>Affinity Range.
ClientAbilities.name: Warcry

ClientAbilities.description: Valkyr hurls forth a hook and pulls herself to whatever it hits. If it hits an enemy, nearby foes are pulled in as she unleashes a coordinated Melee attack.
ClientAbilities.name: Rip Line

ClientAbilities.description: Valkyr bares her deadly claws, unleashing devastating attacks that also heal her. Valkyr becomes immune to Status Effects and her Armor bonus from Warcry is multiplied while using the claws.
ClientAbilities.name: Hysteria

ClientAbilities.description: Unleash a damaging blast, slowing its victims while increasing their Melee Damage Vulnerability.
ClientAbilities.name: Paralysis

ClientAbilities.description: Summon a Bulwark rock-wall, activate again to send the rocks crashing toward the enemy. Bulwarks attacked by enemies release an area-of-effect Slash powered by the Health it has lost.
ClientAbilities.name: Tectonics

ClientAbilities.description: Atlas' hardened gaze will fossilize foes increasing the damage they take, heal Rumblers, and create Petrified Bulwarks. When shattered, petrified enemies drop healing Rubble for Atlas.
ClientAbilities.name: Petrify

ClientAbilities.description: Bash enemies with an explosive sliding punch, repeat up to three times for a combo attack. Each hit in the three-punch combo increases the radius of the attack. Energy cost is reduced with each hit of Landslide. Install mods on the Landslide Fists to boost stats.
ClientAbilities.name: Landslide

ClientAbilities.description: Summon two elemental stone brawlers to the melee. Summoning petrifies enemies in close proximity to Atlas. When finished, Rumblers collapse into a pile of healing Rubble.
ClientAbilities.name: Rumblers

ClientAbilities.description: Temporarily shed the outer pieces of Xaku in a destructive blast, then stalk the battlefield in a new, swifter skeletal form. Enemies damaged by the body shrapnel are rendered weaker to <DT_RADIANT_COLOR>Void Damage. Xaku's other active abilities' duration is frozen in time and resumes once The Vast Untime expires.
ClientAbilities.name: The Vast Untime

ClientAbilities.description: Cycle through a trio of lost Warframe powers. Accuse manifests a Void fissure to corrupt enemies into allies. Gaze grasps targets in Void tendrils that capture damage and inflict it when the target is released. Deny annihilates with a beam of Void energy, wiping Sentient resistances.
ClientAbilities.name: The Lost

ClientAbilities.description: Void Tendrils steal weapons from nearby enemies to use as your own floating, auto-targeting armament. Damage output increases based on enemy level. The number of weapons grabbed also determines the damage multiplier for The Lost: Deny's Void beam.
ClientAbilities.name: Grasp of Lohk

ClientAbilities.description: Wield <DT_RADIANT_COLOR>Void Damage for all attacks from equipped weapons when activated.
ClientAbilities.name: Xata's Whisper

ClientAbilities.description: Cycle through three songs that strengthen allies. Power of The Seven increases Ability Strength. Deathbringer increases Weapon Damage. Spirit of Resilience increases Shield Effectiveness. Extend the duration of each song by killing enemies surrounded by Judgments.
ClientAbilities.name: Symphony of Mercy

ClientAbilities.description: Soar with destructive power. Use alternate-fire to detonate Judgments, causing an explosion of Jade Light. Enemies inside the Light's Judgment radius empower the explosion.
ClientAbilities.name: Glory on High

ClientAbilities.description: Jade summons an accusatory gaze that slows nearby enemies and dissolves their Shields and Armor. When the gaze falls upon allies, they can be revived from a distance.
ClientAbilities.name: Ophanim Eyes

ClientAbilities.description: Create a well of light that heals allies and hurts enemies. Those who enter the well will be highlighted by Judgments.
ClientAbilities.name: Light's Judgment

ClientAbilities.description: Guard yourself and nearby allies against Status Effects. Each time Qorvex kills or assists in killing an enemy affected by <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Status, the number of Status Effects Disometric Guard can prevent increases.
ClientAbilities.name: Disometric Guard

ClientAbilities.description: Release a beam from Qorvex's Crucible Core. Each enemy struck suffers <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Damage with a guaranteed Status Effect. Enemies affected by <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Status explode in a chain reaction.
ClientAbilities.name: Crucible Blast

ClientAbilities.description: Summon a Chyrinka Pillar that slows enemies. It pulses <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Damage with a guaranteed Status Effect.
ClientAbilities.name: Chyrinka Pillar

ClientAbilities.description: Contain the threat. Qorvex summons walls that slam together, damaging all enemies caught between them and inflicting <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Status.
ClientAbilities.name: Containment Wall

ClientAbilities.description: When activated, this power stores damage caused by guns. When triggered again, that damage is channelled through the next gunshot.
ClientAbilities.name: Ballistic Battery

ClientAbilities.description: With intense focus, Mesa draws her Regulator pistols, shooting down her foes in rapid succession.
ClientAbilities.name: Peacemaker

ClientAbilities.description: Envelops Mesa in a barrier of energy, reflecting back incoming bullet damage.
ClientAbilities.name: Shatter Shield

ClientAbilities.description: Gives an ally Extra Damage while jamming the guns of nearby enemies. This power shifts between team members.
ClientAbilities.name: Shooting Gallery

ClientAbilities.description: Supercharge Dagath's weapons with extra Critical Damage. The effects are doubled on Doomed enemies. Escape fatal blows by briefly assuming a spectral form.
ClientAbilities.name: Grave Spirit

ClientAbilities.description: Condemn nearby enemies to their doom. A portion of the damage Dagath deals is revisited upon them by a Wyrd Scythe. They also suffer <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral Damage.
ClientAbilities.name: Doom

ClientAbilities.description: Phantom Kaithes charge forth, inflicting <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral Damage upon all in their path. Their attack strips the defenses of Doomed enemies.
ClientAbilities.name: Rakhali's Cavalry

ClientAbilities.description: Wyrd Scythes surround Dagath and seek out nearby enemies. Those struck are slowed and suffer <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral Damage with a guaranteed Status Effect. The scythes also spread Doom and extend its duration.
ClientAbilities.name: Wyrd Scythes

ClientAbilities.description: Uriel and his demons create a growing ring of flaming brimstone. Charge the ability by utilizing demon abilities. Damage inflicted increases with each consecutive hit.
ClientAbilities.name: Brimstone

ClientAbilities.description: Uriel rips out the souls of his demons, draining their health, and sends them in search of new victims. Souls explode on contact with an enemy, rendering it vulnerable to Damage.
ClientAbilities.name: Demonium

ClientAbilities.description:
Manifest an aura of flames inflicting <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage and Status Effect on nearby enemies.

Tap Dodge while airborne to take flight as a flaming meteor of destruction.
ClientAbilities.name: Infernalis

ClientAbilities.description: Uriel heals himself and his demons. If his demons are dead, they are resurrected.
ClientAbilities.name: Remedium

values.LocalizeDescTag: [HC] Used to create the rewinding effect for that stage

ClientAbilities.description: Uriel rips out the souls of his demons, draining their health, and sends them in search of new victims. Souls explode on contact with an enemy, rendering it vulnerable to Damage.
ClientAbilities.name: Demonium

ClientAbilities.description: Grendel curls into a ball. He heals over time as he rolls, knocking over anyone in his path. Jumping slams Grendel into the ground and generates a damaging shockwave.
ClientAbilities.name: Pulverize

ClientAbilities.description: Regenerate health as Grendel absorbs nourishment from enemies in his gut. While he digests, enemies that attack or are attacked by Grendel suffer <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral Damage and energy sources provide more energy. These buffs extend to squad mates.
ClientAbilities.name: Nourish

ClientAbilities.description: Swallow enemies whole and store them in Grendel's gut. Hold to vomit out stored enemies, covering them in toxic bile.
ClientAbilities.name: Feast

ClientAbilities.description: Violently puke out a bile soaked enemy from Grendel's gut, turning the consumed into a toxic projectile. Nearby enemies are slowed and have their armor dissolved by the bile.
ClientAbilities.name: Regurgitate

ClientAbilities.description: Exhale a deep breath of elemental destruction. Tap to cycle through elements, hold to cast. The chosen element applies to all of Chroma's abilities.
ClientAbilities.name: Spectral Scream

ClientAbilities.description: Depending on Chroma's elemental alignment, an offensive area-of-effect is created. Chroma and its nearby allies are imbued with defensive energy.
ClientAbilities.name: Elemental Ward

ClientAbilities.description: Chroma turns his pelt into a massive sentry that strengthens nearby allies and engulfs enemies in elemental attacks.
ClientAbilities.name: Effigy

ClientAbilities.description: Chroma fortifies squad Armor when his Shields are damaged or he kills an enemy with a melee weapon. He increases squad Weapon Damage when he loses Health or he kills an enemy with a ranged weapon, double the effect on weak point kills.
ClientAbilities.name: Vex Armor

ClientAbilities.description: Protect Ember with flame armor that burns stronger over time, consuming energy once its meter is at full strength. Cast again to extinguish the flame.
ClientAbilities.name: Immolation

ClientAbilities.description: Command a flaming comet to crash down in front of Ember, engulfing enemies with a fire that can spread through their ranks.
ClientAbilities.name: Inferno

ClientAbilities.description: Release a fiery projectile that ignites enemies on contact.
ClientAbilities.name: Fireball

ClientAbilities.description: Slam the ground to create a wave of incinerating plasma that knocks back enemies and strips their armor.
ClientAbilities.name: Fire Blast

ClientAbilities.description: Skewer and hold a target, siphoning their health. Use again to hurl the victim damaging them and anyone near the impact site.
ClientAbilities.name: Meathook

ClientAbilities.description: Launch a pattern of charged mines all around you. Each mine detonates in a violent blast when touched, damaging enemies in a three-meter radius.
ClientAbilities.name: Gravemines

ClientAbilities.description: Hurl a canister of graviton fluids to create a wide mire that will significantly slow enemies traveling across it. Alternatively, the canister can be shot in mid-air to create a fiery conflagration.
ClientAbilities.name: Necraweb

ClientAbilities.description: Sweep surrounding enemies into the line of fire and suspend them in air with a force beam.
ClientAbilities.name: Firing Line

ClientAbilities.description: Raise Bonewidow's shield to block incoming forward damage, reflecting it back at attackers. While active, bash enemies with a Maiden's Kiss.
ClientAbilities.name: Shield Maiden

ClientAbilities.description: Swathe the Necramech in a powerful electrical field that greatly enhances survivability in close combat. Enemies that strike the shroud will suffer for their impudence.
ClientAbilities.name: Storm Shroud

ClientAbilities.description: Summon a devastating exalted blade.
ClientAbilities.name: Exalted Ironbride

ClientAbilities.description: Take a stationary stance to deploy maximum firepower and gain increased structural integrity for a time.
ClientAbilities.name: Guard Mode

ClientAbilities.description: Emit a bright flash of light, blinding all nearby enemies.
ClientAbilities.name: Radial Blind

ClientAbilities.description: Radial javelins impale nearby enemies, inflicting <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status.
ClientAbilities.name: Radial Javelin

ClientAbilities.description: Slash and dash through enemies alongside a radial specter. The powerful Exalted Blade’s slashes inflict <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status.
ClientAbilities.name: Slash Dash

ClientAbilities.description: Summon a sword of pure light and immense power.
ClientAbilities.name: Exalted Blade

ClientAbilities.description: Radial javelins impale nearby enemies, inflicting <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status.
ClientAbilities.name: Radial Javelin

ClientAbilities.description: Let out ferocious howl that stuns nearby enemies and causes Sentients to shed any built up resistances.
ClientAbilities.name: Radial Howl

ClientAbilities.description: Slash and dash through enemies alongside a radial specter. The powerful Exalted Blade’s slashes inflict <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status.
ClientAbilities.name: Slash Dash

ClientAbilities.description: Summon a sword of pure light and immense power.
ClientAbilities.name: Exalted Blade

ClientAbilities.description: Enemies fumble their weapons as they are whisked into the air. Nearby allies become immune to Status Effects. Hold the ability to cast the immunity onto Titania.
ClientAbilities.name: Spellbind

ClientAbilities.description: Shrink down and take flight, while razorflies attack nearby enemies and amplify the damage they take.
ClientAbilities.name: Razorwing

ClientAbilities.description: Create a swarm of razorflies that transform an enemy into an irresistible floating beacon, attracting witless comrades before exploding on command.
ClientAbilities.name: Lantern

ClientAbilities.description: Cycle through and extract one of the four Buffs when cast on an enemy. Thorns reduces incoming damage. Dust degrades enemy accuracy. Full Moon increases companion damage. Entangle slows enemies within range.
ClientAbilities.name: Tribute

ClientAbilities.description: Summons a treacherous landslide of ice that instantly freezes and shatters all enemies in its radius.
ClientAbilities.name: Avalanche

ClientAbilities.description: Frost deep freezes any vapor and moisture in the area, creating a protective sphere with brief invulnerability to boost its strength.
ClientAbilities.name: Snow Globe

ClientAbilities.description: Sends a wave of razor sharp, crystalized ice toward an enemy, dealing heavy damage.
ClientAbilities.name: Ice Wave

ClientAbilities.description: A frigid energy blast that freezes targets in their tracks.
ClientAbilities.name: Freeze

ClientAbilities.description:
Throw two Elemental Ammo Packs that instantly refill the active weapon’s magazine, while granting the weapon an additional instance of the selected Elemental Damage and Status Effect. Reload clears the effect. Sniper Rifles gain extra damage.

Hold the ability to select the Elemental Damage type.
ClientAbilities.name: Resupply

ClientAbilities.description: Jump backwards and become invisible for a short duration. Killing enemies on their Weak Points extends the duration and heals Cyte-09.
ClientAbilities.name: Evade

ClientAbilities.description: Plant an antenna that projects a forward wave scan. Detected enemies take increased Weak Point Damage, and become visible through walls. Weapons gain Punch through.
ClientAbilities.name: Seek

ClientAbilities.description: Summon the Neutralizer, Cyte-09’s exalted Sniper Rifle. Bullets ricochet off Weak Points to seek out other nearby Weak Points. Alt fire lobs a <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold grenade that completely freezes enemies.
ClientAbilities.name: Neutralize

ClientAbilities.description: Garuda sacrifices her health to generate energy and clear Status Effects.
ClientAbilities.name: Bloodletting

ClientAbilities.description: Rip the life force from an enemy and use it as a shield that captures damage, this kills significantly weakened enemies instantly. Charge to channel the captured damage into an explosive projectile.
ClientAbilities.name: Dread Mirror

ClientAbilities.description: Impale an enemy on an altar of talons and siphon health for Garuda and her allies.
ClientAbilities.name: Blood Altar

ClientAbilities.description: Charge to expand the targeting area, release to send Garuda's talons careening toward each target in area. Surviving enemies are prone to <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status.
ClientAbilities.name: Seeking Talons

ClientAbilities.description: Deploy a gem that shoots prismatic beams. The gem targets enemies that are taking weapon damage from Citrine and her allies. Its beams inflict Heat, Cold, Toxin, and Electricity Status Effects. Status Chance and Status Duration increase for nearby allies.
ClientAbilities.name: Prismatic Gem

ClientAbilities.description: Citrine summons crystal fractals. The fractals rush forward, seeking enemies. Enemies touched by the fractals are paralyzed by crystalline growths. Hit the growths to deal Critical Damage.
ClientAbilities.name: Crystallize

ClientAbilities.description: Slash and stagger enemies with a crystal blast that inflicts <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status. Enemies afflicted with this Status Effect have an increased chance of dropping Health and Energy Orbs.
ClientAbilities.name: Fractured Blast

ClientAbilities.description: Citrine guards herself and nearby allies with a crystalline shell that gradually decays. Kills and assists increase the defensive power of the shell.
ClientAbilities.name: Preserving Shell

ClientAbilities.description: Trap enemies in a carousel of mirrors, forcing them to attack visions of their true selves. Destroyed mirrors damage their attackers, as does the collapse of the carousel.
ClientAbilities.name: Spectrorage

ClientAbilities.description: Create an expanding ring of molten glass that slowly crystallizes enemies who enter. When the expansion is complete, the ring hardens to block weapons fire. The ring draws extra strength from the health and shields of crystallized enemies. Use Shattered Lash to smash the ring and send razor-sharp glass flying.
ClientAbilities.name: Mass Vitrify

ClientAbilities.description: Lash out with stream of shattered glass, or hold for an arcing strike. Stats are boosted by the equipped mods on Shattered Lash.
ClientAbilities.name: Shattered Lash

ClientAbilities.description: Gara's armor splinters into a maelstrom of shattered glass. Allies who contact the cloud are fortified against damage.
ClientAbilities.name: Splinter Storm

ClientAbilities.description: Gain a brief burst of increased Critical Chance and Energy Regen, with each kill extending duration of Cathode Grace. Casting is on a cooldown.
ClientAbilities.name: Cathode Grace

ClientAbilities.description: Gyre’s mechanisms spin at incredible speeds, generating an Electric Field that shocks nearby enemies. When Gyre gets a critical hit, a large electrical discharge will chain from the enemy that was hit to nearby enemies.
ClientAbilities.name: Rotorswell

ClientAbilities.description: Launch a Gyratory Sphere that will deal high damage on impact and periodically deal electrical shocks to nearby enemies. Hit multiple enemies at once with the initial launch to enhance damage.
ClientAbilities.name: Arcsphere

ClientAbilities.description: Throw forward a Gyratory Sphere that will implode after a few seconds or can be manually triggered.
ClientAbilities.name: Coil Horizon

ClientAbilities.description: Booby trap nearby objects while conjuring an irresistible jewel that bursts with radial blind when touched in darkness, or a radial explosion in light. Conjure multiple smaller jewels with the help of Hall of Mirrors.
ClientAbilities.name: Sleight of Hand

ClientAbilities.description: Mirage creates an entourage of doppelgangers to confuse and distract the enemy.
ClientAbilities.name: Hall of Mirrors

ClientAbilities.description:
(TAP) Temporarily reduce the damage Mirage takes from enemies.
(HOLD) Temporarily increase Mirage's weapon damage.
ClientAbilities.name: Eclipse

ClientAbilities.description: Fires an energy prism that shoots lasers in all directions. Activating again detonates the prism, blinding nearby foes.
ClientAbilities.name: Prism

ClientAbilities.description: Exude might and valor. Rise into the air and throw a barrage of Axios Javelins. The javelins deal damage to nearby enemies wherever they land. Direct hits to enemies deal greater damage.
ClientAbilities.name: Final Stand

ClientAbilities.description: Summon Tharros, the shield of Styanax. Swing Tharros to repel enemies and reduce their shields and armor. Styanax regenerates health for every enemy struck.
ClientAbilities.name: Tharros Strike

ClientAbilities.description: Throw an Axios Javelin. When the javelin impales an enemy against a wall, surrounding enemies are pulled into the area and suffer a burst of damage.
ClientAbilities.name: Axios Javelin

ClientAbilities.description: Draw enemy attention to Styanax. His resolve uplifts him and nearby allies, regenerating the squad's energy over time. Styanax and his allies also regenerate shields for every kill assist they contribute.
ClientAbilities.name: Rally Point

ClientAbilities.description: Bind to a target with parasitic link. When cast on an ally, both the host and Nidus have their Ability Strength and Weapon Damage increased. Linked enemies take some of the damage inflicted on Nidus.
ClientAbilities.name: Parasitic Link

ClientAbilities.description: Gluttonous maggots swarm nearby enemies, feasting until they are hit with Virulence and burst with Infestation. The maggots benefit from Mutation and each enemy hit adds to the Mutation stack.
ClientAbilities.name: Ravenous

ClientAbilities.description: Rupture the ground with a damaging fungal growth that steals energy from each enemy it strikes. For every five enemies hit, the Infestation mutates, multiplying its destructive force.
ClientAbilities.name: Virulence

ClientAbilities.description: Spawn an Infested pod that erupts with tendrils, latches onto nearby enemies and pulls them in. Enemies killed while held have a chance of generating a Mutation stack.
ClientAbilities.name: Larva

ClientAbilities.description: Tie nearby enemies to floating balloons that douse them with Inkblot. Pop the balloons to send them crashing to the ground, splashing damage on nearby enemies.
ClientAbilities.name: Plein Air

ClientAbilities.description: Draw an ink effigy to absorb the damage dealt to Follie and allies. Below, a pool of ink spreads Inkblot. Kill enemies inside the pool to grow Follie's effigy and its ink puddle.
ClientAbilities.name: Self Portrait

ClientAbilities.description: Drop through an inky frame and emerge invulnerable at the aimed location in a splash of ink that inflicts Inkblot on nearby enemies.
ClientAbilities.name: Forced Perspective

ClientAbilities.description:
Bring shadowgraphs from Follie's sketchbook to life as items that can be used for tactical advantage. Shadowgraphs splash Inkblot onto nearby enemies when created.

HOLD to open the Shadowgraph gear wheel.
ClientAbilities.name: Shadowgraph

ClientAbilities.description: Create a shield aura around allies. Enemies that approach Hildryn will take <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Damage.
ClientAbilities.name: Haven

ClientAbilities.description: Charge and launch devastating bolts of electricity.
ClientAbilities.name: Balefire

ClientAbilities.description: Take the skies and rain Balefire rockets down on the enemy. Nearby enemies are blasted into the air where they will create an Energy Orb every few seconds. When shields run out the enemies are smashed into the ground.
ClientAbilities.name: Aegis Storm

ClientAbilities.description: Pillage a percentage of Shields and Armor of nearby enemies to replenish Hildryn's own Shields and Overshields. Also removes Status Effects from Hildryn and her allies.
ClientAbilities.name: Pillage

ClientAbilities.description: Nyx releases a devastating psychic pulse, disorienting enemies in a wide radius and forcing them to turn on each other. Confused foes lash out at random factions.
ClientAbilities.name: Chaos

ClientAbilities.description: Nyx unleashes a volley of psychic bolts that track and strike nearby enemies with telekinetic precision. When enemies are slain, additional bolts scatter to new targets. Striking foes weakens their defenses and transfers a portion to Nyx.
ClientAbilities.name: Psychic Bolts

ClientAbilities.description: Nyx seizes control of a target's mind, compelling them to fight for the Tenno cause. Controlled enemies have increased <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Status Chance. When Nyx shoots them, they also have an increased Damage Multiplier.
ClientAbilities.name: Mind Control

ClientAbilities.description: Nyx draws in and contains the damage dealt to her and the damage confused enemies deal to each other then converts it into a devastating radial blast. Following the blast, she enters a brief invulnerable state and gains a Weapon Damage boost proportional to the absorbed damage.
ClientAbilities.name: Absorb

ClientAbilities.description: Weave a dome of living chain that ensnares and strangles any enemy within, and any foolish enough to approach. Foes outside the trap will try to hasten their comrade's deaths by shooting them. Crack Whipclaw on the dome to further damage any trapped enemies.
ClientAbilities.name: Strangledome

ClientAbilities.description: Send enemies reeling with a deafening whipcrack. Stats are boosted by the equipped mods on Whipclaw.
ClientAbilities.name: Whipclaw

ClientAbilities.description: Command Venari to focus on a target. Hold to cycle between Attack, Protect, and Heal postures. If Venari is killed, use this ability to revive her instantly.
ClientAbilities.name: Venari

ClientAbilities.description: Bind a hapless target in living metal, entangling others who stray too close. Whipclaw will refresh the trap allowing it to capture more enemies.
ClientAbilities.name: Ensnare

ClientAbilities.description:
Surround yourself with Omamori Charms, each with a chance to have enemy attacks heal you instead of damage you. The number of charms is determined by Koumei's dice roll.

A roll of triple sixes grants invulnerability for the duration of your Omamori Charms.
ClientAbilities.name: Omamori

ClientAbilities.description:
Koumei glimpses a favorable future and the precise steps needed to reach it. Complete the challenge to earn a Decree. Unlucky rolls add a debuff, but you can hold the ability to reject the Omikuji.

A roll of triple sixes grants a Decree without a challenge.
ClientAbilities.name: Omikuji

ClientAbilities.description:
Wield your foe’s fate threads like the strings of marionettes. Koumei’s dice determine how many Status Effects foes in front of Koumei will suffer.

A roll of triple sixes causes further Status Effects over time and extends Bunraku to enemies behind Koumei.

A roll of triple sixes creates threads that inflict one of every Elemental Status Effect.

ClientAnimals.description: The Vasca strain is a symbiotic blood-borne virus transmitted via the saliva of infected Kavats. Existing solely to propagate itself the virus makes the host increasingly dependent upon the ingestion of blood, thereby spreading itself further and faster through the population. Vasca-infected kavats, over time, lose all sense of themselves becoming increasingly cunning, violent and ravenous.
ClientAnimals.name: Vasca

How to play:

To join this living defense, or ‘Murmur Telemetry Chorus,' you must hunt down the power source that'll continuously power your Vigile Jahu Gargoyle.

1. Go to your Dojo and build the Vigile Jahu Gargoyle from your Dojo Decorations. Only one Gargoyle can be built per Dojo, so if you don't see it in your Decoration list, your Clan Members may have already placed it!

2. Play Effervo on Deimos to earn Operation rewards. Players must successfully defeat both the Void Angel and the Assassination Target in-mission to earn one of the following:
  • Curse of Knowing (The Fragmented Suzerain)
  • Curse of Seeing (The Fragmented Anchorite)
  • Curse of Hearing (The Fragmented Zelator)

Earn 1 Curse per Normal Path mission, or double of the same Curse on Steel Path.

Successfully defeating the Assassination Target also rewards Grotesque Splinters. 

3. Return to your Dojo and feed the Curses to your Vigile Jahu Gargoyle every week to contribute to a Clan Trophy. Contribute Curses each week to hit the Cap and improve your Clan Scoring -- resulting in better Trophies at the end!

4. Visit the Vigile Jahu Gargoyle to exchange Grotesque Splinters for various Operation rewards!

ClientBundles.description:
Konzu has a problem, a massive Infested Boil has broken through Earth's atmosphere, crashing down outside Cetus. As the boil grows, it spawns rabid Infested putting all life on the plains in jeopardy.

How to play:

Visit Konzu and initiate the Plague Star bounty
1. Head out onto the plains and find a Toxin Canister hidden within one of the Grineer caves
2. Take the canister to a mixing machine and defend the machine while it mixes 
3. Deposit the mixed toxin into a drone
4. Escort the drone to the boil
5. Kill off the Infested released from the boil. 

The Toxin can be augmented in two ways:
1. Eidolon Phylaxis can be created from a blueprint purchased from Nakak, and increases toxin lethality
2. Infested Catalyst is made in the Bio Lab in your clan's dojo, and causes the boil to spawn a massive Hemocyte

You must have Eidolon Phylaxis and Infested Catalyst in your inventory to run the Advanced and Steel Path Bounties.
ClientBundles.name: PLAGUE STAR

ClientBundles.description: Creation and destruction intermingle in this ethereal bundle for Wisp. Contains Wisp, her signature Fulmin lightning rifle, Sirocco Kavat Armor, the alternate Gaoth Helmet as well as 3-day credit and affinity boosters.
ClientBundles.name: Wisp Collection

ClientBundles.description: A bundle featuring a Man in the Wall and Albrecht Entrati Glyph from Community Artists SirEnarion & death_ma666ots
ClientBundles.name: Whispers in the Walls Community Glyph Bundle

ClientBundles.description: The signature battle armor of the only lunatic fearsome enough to have escaped the Saturn Six Max-Pen.
ClientBundles.name: Saturn Six Armor Bundle

ClientBundles.description: A pair of glyphs depicting the Wolf of Saturn Six.
ClientBundles.name: Wolf of Saturn Six Glyph Bundle

ClientBundles.description: The Yuvan Clerisy commissioned these golden statues to honor Lua's guardian pack. They are now yours to cherish. The collection includes the Steadfast Dynar Bust, Steadfast Raksh Bust, Steadfast Lycath Bust, and Steadfast Ulfrun Bust.
ClientBundles.name: The Honored Pack Collection

ClientBundles.description: A collection of Immortal Wukong items, including Wukong Samadhi Skin, Meteor Whip Skin, and the Subhuti Syandana.
ClientBundles.name: Wukong Samadhi Collection

ClientBundles.description:
Adorn Wukong in the morphic material created during the Zariman Void Jump. This collection includes the Wukong Voidshell Skin and Rubedo Impression material structure.

Material structures are exclusive to Voidshell skins.
ClientBundles.name: Wukong Voidshell Collection

ClientBundles.description: Decorate your Orbiter with a complete set of Gallixware ceramics. Each piece was handcrafted by the esteemed Orokin artist, Bren Terrasiam. The bundle includes three vases, a plate, a bowl, and an amphora.
ClientBundles.name: Gallixware Ceramics Bundle

ClientBundles.description: Deck the Necralisk with these festive Tennobaum Glyphs!
ClientBundles.name: Entrati Tennobaum Glyph Bundle

ClientBundles.description: Pathfinders will use this collection well. Express the Zariman spirit of innovation with the Parallax Landing Craft and its four unique skins.
ClientBundles.name: Parallax Landing Craft Collection

ClientBundles.description:
Don morphic material created during the Zariman Void Jump. This collection includes fifteen material structures.

Material structures are exclusive to Voidshell skins.
ClientBundles.name: Hombask's Voidshell Bundle

ClientBundles.description:
Make the most of morphic material created during the Zariman Void Jump. This collection includes the Saryn Voidshell Skin, Volt Voidshell Skin, Rhino Voidshell Skin, each skin’s matching material structure, and fifteen additional materials structures.

Material structures are exclusive to Voidshell skins.
ClientBundles.name: Void Adornment Bundle

ClientSyndicates.description: The dogmatic Arbiters seek a truth through discipline and practice. They reject the Tenno as Warrior mythology... A lie constructed to limit their potential.
ClientSyndicates.name: Arbiters of Hexis

ClientSyndicates.description: A vast consciousness watching with a curious eye. Seemingly devoid of emotion, Suda's thirst for knowledge and abhorrence of destruction can only be described as passionate.
ClientSyndicates.name: Cephalon Suda

ClientSyndicates.description: A warrior only grows if they face the ultimate enemy. Themselves.
ClientSyndicates.name: Conclave

ClientSyndicates.description: Heirs to the legacy of Albrecht Entrati, his powerful Orokin family encountered disaster, isolation and bitter division on Deimos. The arrival of the Tenno, beneficiaries of their Void research, may bring fresh hope - and a deeper understanding of the world that has trapped their family.
ClientSyndicates.name: Entrati

ClientSyndicates.description: While the Entrati family's cohort of lethal Necramechs succumbed to the corrupting influence of Deimos, Loid's shielding kept him sane, as well as preserving what was left of his ‘passenger', the Cephalon Otak. Together they maintain a proud tradition of loyal service.
ClientSyndicates.name: Necraloid

ClientSyndicates.description: Animals sent into the Void by Albrecht Entrati, the three surviving Cavia came back changed forever. They gained human intelligence, but could speak only incoherent Voidtongue until the Jahu Gargoyle made them intelligible. Despite what Albrecht did to them, they have resolved to assist his chosen Operator.
ClientSyndicates.name: Cavia

ClientSyndicates.description: Support and rewards for Tenno fighting in active operations.
ClientSyndicates.name: Operational Supply

ClientSyndicates.description: Formerly human operatives, the six members of the Hex were transformed into Protoframes by Albrecht Entrati. Filled with uncanny power and mourning their lost humanity, they continue their mission of mercy in beleaguered Höllvania.
ClientSyndicates.name: The Hex

ClientSyndicates.description: Break veils. Free Brothers. Stop Narmer.
ClientSyndicates.name: Garrison

ClientSyndicates.description: Through Synthesis we can rebuild and preserve. Create memory-immortals within this data oasis. Will you become enlightened, Tenno? Will you hunt for me?
ClientSyndicates.name: Cephalon Simaris

ClientSyndicates.description: Only through the restoration of a pure humanity and the repopulation of Earth can the conflict end. The New Loka are worshipers of the human form and Earth, before its corruption.
ClientSyndicates.name: New Loka

ClientSyndicates.description: Find Mushroom samples in the Deepmines
ClientSyndicates.name: Nightcap

ClientSyndicates.description: A tight knit band of merchants, hucksters, and survivors, the Ostrons call Cetus their home. The town was built around an Orokin Tower, that both protects and nourishes them.
ClientSyndicates.name: Ostron

ClientSyndicates.description: A secretive order, loyal to the mysterious and reclusive 'Unum.' Some say their relationship to cause and effect is unnatural, their knowledge profane. When a Quill acts, things change.
ClientSyndicates.name: The Quills

ClientSyndicates.description: A collective of brilliant and powerful merchants, splintered from the Corpus. Their goal is to restore order by bringing prosperity and direction to the violent world they study.
ClientSyndicates.name: The Perrin Sequence

ClientSyndicates.description: The Veil see corruption all around them. They are honor-bound to heal the system through a great and violent purge. No cost too great, no blood too precious.
ClientSyndicates.name: Red Veil

ClientSyndicates.description: Indentured workers to the Corpus; the indispensable backbone of the Corpus business model on Venus. Manning factories, rail tractors and mines they work to pay off the artificial bodies (rigs) they bought in order to work.
ClientSyndicates.name: Solaris

ClientSyndicates.description: Hangin' with their logical fam in the ducts of Fortuna, the Ventkids get by stealing parts from the Corpus and running K-Drive races out on the Vallis. At night the ventways bang to the sound of skeg - to the chagrin of the locals.
ClientSyndicates.name: Ventkids

ClientSyndicates.description: Solaris United's core personnel operating under the name of that group's enigmatic and anonymous figurehead. SU is the public face of the struggle. Vox Solaris is something else entirely; something known only to Eudico... and the Quills.
ClientSyndicates.name: Vox Solaris

ClientSyndicates.description: Led by a battle-hardened Grineer deserter, the Steel Meridian fight a guerrilla war against a vast enemy. They are sworn protectors of what little remains of the colonies.
ClientSyndicates.name: Steel Meridian

ClientSyndicates.description: Granted a second existence through the mysterious power of the Void, the four Holdfasts struggle to keep their sanity and their vessel intact. The return of the Tenno may turn the tide.
ClientSyndicates.name: The Holdfasts
